parameters.query: WITH recent_sources AS (SELECT 'source_observation'::text AS item_type, id::text AS item_id, item_title AS title, left(coalesce(item_url,''),200) AS ref, collected_at AS at FROM source_observations WHERE collected_at > now() - interval '14 days' AND id::text NOT IN (SELECT from_id FROM vault_links WHERE from_type='source_observation') ORDER BY collected_at DESC LIMIT 25), recent_runs AS (SELECT 'local_llm_run'::text AS item_type, run_key::text AS item_id, task_name AS title, left(coalesce(result_summary,''),200) AS ref, updated_at AS at FROM local_llm_runs WHERE status='complete' AND updated_at > now() - interval '14 days' AND run_key::text NOT IN (SELECT from_id FROM vault_links WHERE from_type='local_llm_run') ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 25) SELECT * FROM recent_sources UNION ALL SELECT * FROM recent_runs ORDER BY at DESC;

INSERT INTO vault_links(from_type, from_id, to_type, to_id, relation, reason, provider, model) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,'ollama-local','qwen3.5:4b') ON CONFLICT (from_type, from_id, to_type, to_id, relation) DO NOTHING RETURNING id;
